content: KRAISTNA MAAWUPMBA YETƗ NGWULA
Ngwuk wimbu kɨlɨga nɨmba kɨlapman nɨmba yetɨlɨga vapmba yetɨngweyan wovuna. Ngwutna yelavɨk vapmba ke yetɨga.
Nat nyana yelavɨk vapmba yetɨ. Ndina yelavɨk vapmba yetɨngweyan ndi God waa nyaangɨk kat kai ana waigandi.
Jisas Kraist wan vapmba yetɨndɨ. Ndɨna maawupmba ana yetɨndɨ. Tamba la nɨmba Jisas kat pɨlɨwutndi. Nat nɨmba ndɨ kat kavle vat yinjangat yandɨ waa ndɨ kat pɨlɨwutndi.
God tamba pɨlɨwuta nyaangɨt kwo ana pɨlɨwutndɨ. Nɨn kat sɨmagavat pɨlɨwutndɨ. Tamba la nɨmba God ndina lak kwandɨ vɨlɨganɨn. Ngi kat tɨga nɨna lak kwaigandɨ vɨlɨganɨn.
God nɨna lak kwaga apma vat kwilɨgandɨ. Savagu maawut nɨn kat kwilɨgandɨ. Kwindɨ, maa nɨn kɨta vat apma vat tɨgiyanɨn. Kwindɨ maa Krasit yinda vapmba yetɨgiyanɨn.
Wan vapmba yetɨneyan kɨta nyaangɨtmba yetɨga waiganɨn. God mɨn nɨma nyan mɨn, njambwi nyan Jisas Kraist mɨn nɨma nyan mɨn kɨta nyaangɨpmba waiganɨn.
JUDAGWI NAT NƗMBA KAT GOD NDI KAT KWUNATNDƗ
Kraist ngwuk kat yagwa wandɨ. Wungi kat tɨga awat nɨna lotu yagwa waa awamba.
God Judana ngwak kat paatna nyaangɨt ngambuvat Kraist Juda kat yandɨ.

Ngambundɨ maa Juda ana ndi nat nɨmba wandi. God ndi kat apma vat yindɨ, wandi nat nɨmba. Wan nyaangɨt tamba pɨlɨwutndɨ. Wuno nat nɨmbo Juda ana ndi God kat waiganɨn. Mɨna sɨ waga wamak kwundi waiganɨn waa tamba pɨlɨwutndɨ.
Nat nyan pɨlɨwutndɨ. Ngwut Judanana solat asɨ waa pɨlɨwutndɨ.
Ngwuk Juda ana ngwuk Godna sɨ kwuso. Ngepma ngepmamba lɨga nɨmba ndɨ kat swamba. Mɨn apma nyan mɨn waa awa waa pɨlɨwutndɨ.
Aisaia Jisas kat pɨlɨwutndɨ. Jesina yelangɨ nyan lɨgiyandɨ. Juda ana ndi nat nɨmba kat laataa vɨga lɨgiyandɨ. Ndɨ kat waigandi. Nɨna lak kwaigandɨ waa waigandi waa pɨlɨwutndɨ. Aisaia.

God waa nyaangɨk kat ngwula mbangɨ wiyo waavi taagalɨgandɨ. Solat sɨngweya vat apma maawut tɨngweya vat ngwuk kat God kwindangat wagalalɨgowun. Godna waagan ngwutna maawut ngwandɨndɨ maa God waa nyaangɨk kat ngwula mbangɨ nɨmamba wiyo waavi taagagiyandɨ.
POL NDƗNA NJƗVWA KAT YELAVƗKA SOLAT SƗGA NOLIN NGWANDƗLƗGANDI
Yakwa nɨmba ngwuk apma nɨmba ngwuk. Savagu maawut tɨga nɨmba ngwuk. Ngambuwa nyaangɨt tak tamba wuka lɨngwuk. Wuka lɨga awat sowat sɨmogwingwuk.

Ngwula maawut tɨvɨlandɨ. Wungi kat tɨga wan vak kat pɨlɨwutwun. God apma vat wun kat wandɨ. Wandɨ maa Jisas Kraistna njɨvwa kwutɨga nyan wun. Wungi kat tɨga ngwuk kat pɨlɨwutwun. Juda ana ndi nat nɨmba kat mbukwan kat God wun kat mbutndɨ. Wuna njɨvwa kɨngiyand ndɨ. Godna vak Juda ana ndi wutapman tɨga nɨmba kat ndi kat Godna nyaangɨt mbuka kiyaa ndɨna mbaapmamba taagagowun. Godna waagan ndi kat apma vat yetɨnjangat kwunatɨgandɨ.
Godna nɨjvwa kwukwa njɨvwa Jisas Krasitna ɨmba kwukwun. Wan njɨvwa kat wuna mbangɨ wup ana yigandɨ.
Nat nɨmba Godna njɨvwa kwutɨnjangat ana waigowun. Godna njɨvwa kwukwangat mɨna waigowun. Ndi kat wowun maa God waa nyaangɨtmba yetɨndi. Ndi kat wowun maa God waa nyaangɨtmba yetɨndi.
Ndi kat mbukwun. Wunai yeta vak vɨndi. Kwunatɨwa vak sɨmogwiwun, vɨndi. Wan vak aywaa Godna waagan tavindɨ maa kwukwun. Jerusalemba lɨga Ilirikam yiga kan nyaangɨt mbutɨwun.
Kraistna sɨ wutapma tɨga nɨmba kat yiga mbupmat wowun. God waa nyaangɨt kwutaa lɨga nɨmbana ngepmat yiga mbupmak kat kai wowun. Nat nyan ndi kat tamba mbutndɨ.
Tamba Aisaia yuwa vapmba pɨlɨwutndɨ. God kat wutapman nɨmba wukiyandi. God kat vɨlapman nɨmba vɨgiyandi waa pɨlɨwundɨ Aisaia.
POL ROMBA LƗGA NƗMBA VƗLAA SPENAT YIVAT WANDƗ
Kan njɨvwea wun kat kematɨndi maa tɨwun. Ngwuk kat ana yaa vɨwun.
Kan kavana njɨvwa tamba ngɨlɨgandɨ. Naambi nɨma sakwat kawiga lɨwun. Mbambala lamba laapkowun ngwutnalak yivak kat.
Spen walɨnja ngepmat yivat tɨgowun. Yiga ngwutna ngepma Rom kawivat wowun. Yuisolaa ngambuga lɨga ngwuk kat kwagalalaaa yigiyowun Spenat.
Tat Jerusalemat yigiywoun. Jerusalemba lɨga Godna yelangɨ nɨmba kat kɨta nda kwivat yigiyowun.
Jerusalemba lɨga nat nɨmba nao kɨgɨnda lapman tɨndi. Wungi kat tɨga Masedonia Akaiamba lɨga Juda ana ndi Godna yelangɨ nɨmba kat nɨmbundawi kwindi.
Kwivat wandi, wovuna wowun. Tat Jeruslemba la Juda God waa nyaangɨt wuka lɨndi. Juda ana ndi nat nɨmba kat yiga mbutndi. Awat sowat nɨmbundawi kwinjeyan wovuna wowun.
Wunamba kwindi, yiga agwi wandi. Ndi kat kwilaa Spen yigiyowun. Ngwuk kat vɨvat yigiyowun.
Ngwuk kat mbukweya nyaangɨt njambwi nyan wun kat mbukiyandɨ. Vɨlɨgowun.
Jisas Krasit nɨn kat apma vat yindɨ. Godna waagan nɨna maawut ngwandɨndɨ maa awat sowat woviyaguga lɨganɨn. Wungi kat tɨga yakwa nɨmba ngwuk kat wagalagowun. Wun kat tɨga God kat wagala ngwula.

Nat Jeruslemba lɨga nɨmba God kat kai walɨga nɨmba ndi. Wun kat anagandi sɨgiyaa. Wun kat tɨga nɨma nyan kat wagala. Jerusalemba lɨga Godna yelangɨ nɨmba ndi kat kwiweya nda anagandi klaiga. Wun kat tɨga nyan kat wagala.
Kwiweya nda klanjeyan nolin ngwandɨga ngwutna ngepma yaigowun. God wandɨ, yaigowun. Yawun maa awat sowat maawut kwunkiyanɨn.
God nɨn kat apma maawut kwilɨgandɨ. Ngwutna lak God kwandangat wagalalɨgowun. Ngiyambak.
